title: Agent hooks in Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex explained
summary: Antoine van der Lee replaces a frequently ignored instruction to filter xcodebuild logs with hooks that rewrite or reject unfiltered build commands. An iOS team can move this repeated step into a short, reviewed hook that preserves build failures with pipefail, while testing failure behavior and keeping independent safeguards for paths that bypass hooks.
takeaway: Move repetitive build-output filtering into a reviewed hook; test timeouts, failure behavior, already-filtered commands, and exit-code preservation before enabling it.
